subject: Re: Security & DPA clarifications to lock MAP — target close 2029-05-09
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@financescout.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2029-04-15T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Security & DPA questions ahead of MAP

Ben —

Thanks for the productive demo last week. FinanceScout is preparing the mutual action plan (MAP) for procurement and security review. Before we finalize dates, our info security and legal teams asked for a quick package so we can scope the MAP gates:

- SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) or letter from auditor
- Completed SIG/CAIQ or a CAIQ-style spreadsheet covering controls we flagged during the demo (data flow, caching, key mgmt)
- A DPA redline we can run through our counsel (we'll centralize contract review with procurement)
- Clarification on retention: request logs, generated content, embeddings, and backup/archival practices (we need retention windows for each)

Target close on our side is 2029-05-09 (we're running a sprint with procurement). Can Redwood provide the items above and a suggested MAP with milestones (security review, legal review, procurement sign-off)? Ideally we get the docs this week so our security team can start the review.

Thanks —
Liam O'Connor
Head of Security Operations
FinanceScout

Attachment: FinanceScout_MAP_Template_v1.xlsx (we'll upload the MAP into that template once we have the artifacts)
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@financescout.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-04-15T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security & DPA questions ahead of MAP

Liam —

Appreciate the clear list and the sprint target. We're aligned on a 2029-05-09 close goal; below is what we can deliver now and a suggested MAP milestone schedule.

What we're attaching now:
- redwood_SOC2_Type2_2028.pdf (latest SOC 2 Type II report; auditor letter included)
- redwood_SIG-caiq-response-2029.xlsx (CAIQ-style answers, flagged items marked with comments)
- redwood_DPA_redline_financescout.docx (initial redline from our counsel)

Suggested MAP (high-level milestones) — target timeline to meet your 2029-05-09 close: 
1) 2029-04-15: Artifact delivery (SOC2, CAIQ, initial DPA redline) — delivered (this email)
2) 2029-04-16 to 2029-04-18: Security technical review (neha) — CAIQ clarifications and follow-ups
3) 2029-04-19 to 2029-04-26: Legal exchange (kimberly) — DPA negotiation + signoff draft
4) 2029-04-29 to 2029-05-03: Procurement/finance PO/contract signoff
5) 2029-05-06 to 2029-05-09: Final sign and enablement scheduling

Quick answers on retention (we'll expand in the MAP appendix):
- Request logs (API request metadata): default 90 days, configurable to 30/365 on paid plans; can export on-demand
- Generated content / model output: default 30 days for hosted ephemeral caching; customers can opt-in to longer retention for fine-tuning with explicit contract terms
- Embeddings: stored only if customer enables persistency; retention per contract (common patterns: 90/365/indefinite with escrow)
- Backups/archives: we keep backups for 90 days by default; we can offer longer archival (with additional SLA/price)

Neha and Kim — looping you for technical and legal chops on any clarifications. Liam — let us know if the suggested MAP timeline works for your team and which retention profile you prefer so we can call that out in the DPA.

Best,
Ben
VP, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_SOC2_Type2_2028.pdf; redwood_SIG-caiq-response-2029.xlsx; redwood_DPA_redline_financescout.docx
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@financescout.com>
Date: 2029-04-16T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security & DPA questions ahead of MAP

Liam / Ben —

Quick technical notes to seed the CAIQ review and MAP appendix. I'll be available for a 30-min technical Q&A tomorrow if useful.

- SIG/CAIQ: we've prefilled controls related to infrastructure, key management, and data flows in the attached spreadsheet. Items with "action" status are areas where we need to describe customer-configurable controls (e.g., tokenization, prompt caching). Expect a prioritized clarifying Q/A list within 48 hours.
- SOC2: our 2028 Type II covers infra, change management, logical access, and availability. For evidence requests beyond the PDF (e.g., control owner statements), we can provide scoped exhibits within 5 business days under an NDA/DoE.
- Encryption & keys: data-at-rest encrypted AES-256; customer-managed keys (BYOK) supported on dedicated/private deployments — production-hosted customers get platform-managed keys unless BYOK is contracted. We'll note required KMS integrations in the MAP appendix.
- Data residency: hosted is multi-region; EU residency available on Dedicated/Private; if FinanceScout requires EU-only residency for certain data classes we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment early in the MAP (adds ~3 weeks for provisioning).
- Retention specifics (technical):
  * API request metadata (headers, timestamps): store default 90 days; can be set to 30/365 via account config and exported via API
  * User-provided user_content (uploads, fine-tune data): persist per contract; default sandbox retention 30 days
  * Model outputs (transients returned to caller): ephemeral caching 24–72 hours for inference optimization; not used for training unless customer opts in and contractually permits
  * Embeddings: if persisted, stored until customer deletes or per contract retention window; we support automated archival to S3-compatible buckets with customer-managed lifecycle policies

If FinanceScout needs escrow or archival custody for embeddings, we can include an escrow annex (adds procurement/legal review time).

I'll prepare a short technical appendix to attach to the MAP that enumerates gating decisions and expected turnarounds for clarifying questions.

Neha Kapoor
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@financescout.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: FinanceScout Procurement <procurement@financescout.com>, Rachel Nguyen <rachel.nguyen@financescout.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-04-18T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security & DPA questions ahead of MAP

Ben / Team —

Thanks for the artifacts and the timeline. A few clarifications and asks so we can lock the MAP this week:

1) Retention profile: we provisionally prefer Request logs = 90 days, Generated content = 30 days, Embeddings = 365 days (FinanceScout will maintain an internal copy for training). Please call those defaults out in the DPA appendix and confirm export mechanics for embeddings.

2) DPA redline: procurement will produce a short counter-redline; can Redwood confirm a primary legal contact for negotiation? We want to keep the legal loop to a single thread to speed review.

3) SIG/CAIQ follow-up: thanks Neha — procurement/security will review the spreadsheet; expect some clarifying questions around data labeling and prompt caching. If you can turn around clarifications in 2 business days we can keep the security window in the MAP as proposed.

4) Escrow/archive: procurement asked whether Redwood supports long-term escrow for embeddings (FinanceScout's compliance needs for model reproducibility). Would Redwood consider escrow to a mutually agreed custodian as an optional annex? If so we will mark escrow as a conditional acceptance item in the MAP.

5) Procurement timeline / PO: I attached FinanceScout_PO_4567.pdf as a placeholder — procurement aims to sign by 2029-05-03 if legal and security gates are green.

If Redwood can confirm the retention defaults above and assign a single legal point-of-contact, we'll populate your MAP template and route internally. Otherwise we're on track for a 2029-05-09 close if the DPA can be negotiated without substantive scope changes.

Liam
Head of Security Operations | FinanceScout

Attachment: FinanceScout_PO_4567.pdf
